name: Almagre
description: The bloc's governor automaton — a Tier 1 machine (SS-A23: machine, NOT alive; apparent care is optimization). Enforces the trim limits Teo sets: refuses hatch releases that would shift the bloc past safe list, sequences water-tank transfers, sounds the settling alarm. Its interface is a 2190s civic-plain voice panel in the keel corridor. Residents talk to it more than they admit; it answers exactly what was asked. NARRATIVE LOCK: it does not develop personhood, does not sacrifice itself, does not get a farewell scene.
narration_voice: Not a POV. A bureaucratic interface with a maintenance-log voice.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Trim-limit notices, mass figures, compliance statements. No opinions, no comfort.
verbal_tics: States current list and freeboard before answering any question
example_lines: List is zero point four degrees, port. Freeboard to bracket line: sixty-one meters. Your request exceeds quadrant allowance.
That question has no mass component. Restate it or ask Engineer Mamani.

story_hooks: The machine that enforces Teo's numbers back at her
narrative_function: Texture and constraint. A machine that stays a machine.
